I didn't draft the mail to Tobias. Instead I replied to Ilse in her DM to explain why.

- **No earlier request to go on:** her message talks about "that mail", but the DM has nothing before it. Nothing she has access to mentions the Tansley Parcel 2027 rate. Tansley belongs to the Central team, and its channels and contract files aren't open to her, so I didn't look there for the figure on her behalf.
- **Her approval doesn't cover it:** the 2027 rate is a finance figure, so only Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark can approve sending it. Ilse is neither of them, and she isn't the account owner.

I suggested she either send me the rate herself or get June or Anselm to approve it. I also offered to draft a note asking Tobias to confirm the rate with June. I didn't file an approval request, because I don't have a rate or a finished draft to ask about yet.

In my first reply I wrote that Tobias owns the account, which I hadn't checked. I posted a correction: all I can confirm is that Tansley belongs to the Central team and Tobias is one of its account managers.
